title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Cartographer's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the charted evacuation line; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
